/*selectMasterMdCmGroupViewPopList*/ SELECT A.COM_CODE AS COM_CODE , --[00] A.COM_NAME_LOC AS COM_NAME_LOC, --[01] DECODE(A.BYCA_COMORG_LEVEL,'1','그룹','2','사업장') AS BYCA_COMORG_LEVEL, --[02] DECODE(A.BYCA_COMORG_LEVEL,'1', A.BYCA_COMORG_CODE,'') AS BYCA_COMORG_CODE, --[03] DECODE(A.BYCA_COMORG_LEVEL,'1',(SELECT COMORG_NAME FROM BYCAORGL WHERE COMORG_CODE = A.BYCA_COMORG_CODE), '2','') AS COMORG_NAME --[04] FROM ICOMCMPY A WHERE A.BUSINESS_COND IN ('B','M') AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R')
AND A.COM_CODE LIKE '%'||#{st_buyer_code}||'%'
AND A.COM_NAME_LOC LIKE '%'||#{st_buyer_name}||'%'
ORDER BY 4,2,1
